summary: Iteration 9 — Travel Insurance 3-step flow + Repeat-Customer QuickFill Banner verified. Backend: 12 NEW pytest cases pass in test_travel_quickfill.py covering (a) Travel form_config seeding (11 step1 + 8 step2 fields), (b) POST /api/quotes/travel with rich 22-field payload, privacy-rejection 400, legacy minimal payload backward compat, and pricing multipliers (annual > single, 70_plus > 18_70, domestic < international), (c) auth gating, and (d) GET /api/profile/quick-fill returns has_data=true with all 18 expected keys for the demo customer. Combined with prior 156 tests = 168/168 pass (100%). Frontend: end-to-end flow verified for the demo user — clicking 'Get quote' on Travel Shield Global card → /travel-quote/{id}, all 19 step1 testids present (region/triptype/destinations/traveler-type/age-category/travelers/email/dates/tier/addons/checkboxes/next-btn), QuickFillBanner appears on Travel step 1, Motor step 0, and PA step 1 with name/IC/phone/email chips, Apply button populates fields correctly (verified Demo Customer / 900101-14-1234 / +60123456789), Get Quote → step 3 shows total RM32.57 with breakdown and Pay Now (travel-checkout-btn) present. No frontend code changes needed.

Consider preferring quote-input full_name over user.full_name when seeding the form, or reset demo user's name back to 'Demo Customer' in seed.py (idempotent via $setOnInsert is fine since user already exists).

action_items: (LOW) demo user's full_name in DB has been overwritten to 'SETTINGS TEST' by a prior test/iteration. seed.py should either be idempotent on full_name or this should be reset; currently the QuickFillBanner chips show 'Demo Customer' (correct, from quote.input) but the form's pre-populated Full Name input reads 'SETTINGS TEST' from auth user. Not a blocker for this iteration's deliverables.
critical_code_review_comments: TravelQuote.jsx line 16: `return r.json()['access_token']` — the auth login endpoint returns key 'token' (not 'access_token'). I worked around in the test file by using `j.get('access_token') or j.get('token')`. No frontend impact (frontend reads via lib/auth.js which already handles 'token').

quotes.py: TravelQuoteInput's `destination` field accepts any string — no high_risk warning surfaced to user. Pricing risk_loading is silent. Consider exposing risk_score in the UI's summary card (currently shown only at top in a tiny div).

QuickFillBanner.jsx: dismiss state is per-mount (not localStorage). Clicking Dismiss and re-navigating brings it back. This is documented behavior per E1's note ('dismissible per-session — state only'), but flagging for future UX consideration.
POPULAR_DESTINATIONS hard-coded to 21 countries in TravelQuote.jsx — admin cannot edit this list (only form_config). Per spec this is intentional but worth a comment in the code.

Backend response from /api/quotes/travel includes the full `input` object (which has accept_privacy/full_name/id_number/etc.). Make sure no PII is logged at the structured log level — currently looks fine, only insert_one persists, but worth a security review.
